source_scope: Round 53 sequential review of printed Chapters 942–951 using Bqquge. Cumulative item ledger is EVENT-SOURCE-ITEMS-v5.3.csv. Catalog baseline remains v4.6 with append-only v4.7–v5.3 addenda; fixed schedule unchanged.

confirmed_outcomes.event: An old witch gifts the Death Poison Core relic for an ally's advancement; the party enters the Fortune Ark.
The hidden stage of the S-rank task begins: five allied chess pieces race against an opponent across a 49-space board, using the Lucky God's Dice.
Sarah reaches the level-46 ultimate challenge; its overperformance can award an extra hidden reward.
Sarah defeats the Windmark Lion King and receives the legendary passive Wind Dance Steps.
Xiao earns legendary passive Mountain Soul Power after a level-48 overperformance; Renis earns legendary active Chasing Cloud Dragon-Slaying Arrow after killing the Windcloud Dragon.
Xierda earns legendary active Crimson Spider Nest: Bloodburst after killing the Abyssal Spider Emperor. An opponent's king-piece interference grants five extra rolls and an additional mystery reward.

Malenina earns legendary passive Seven Absolute Swordsmanship. The S-rank task completes and grants Deep Sea Heart Necklace (semi-artifact), Divine Power Fragments x200, and Frost Codex skill book; the book opens to Ice Throne: Royal Coronation. Control of the Fortune Ark is granted and soul-binding succeeds.
The Fortune Ark is confirmed as an initial-tier artifact super-vessel; no new item receipt.

The Deep Sea Heart Necklace is identified as piece 1/3 of the Deep Sea Calamity semi-artifact set. Loot includes two explicitly excavated chests, one Gold and one Moon; not yet incorporated as separate rows.
Fanaaz completes a demi-god transformation using the earlier Calamity Divine Fire and fragments; this is a transformation, not a new item receipt.

non_receipts: Routine chess-square buffs and temporary effects are not added as carried inventory.
The five-roll compensation is a task entitlement rather than an item; it is documented in the item ledger for traceability.
The Ch950 necklace inspection repeats the Ch948 reward and is not counted twice.
The Ch950 two chest excavations are noted as explicit receipts but their opened contents are outside the reviewed chapter scope.
All narrative rewards remain source research, not active LL01 inventory.
